Artillery: Artillery weapon (min–max range, indirect fire). Targets a point in fire arc, range and line of sight (or through an artillery observer). On a grid, a 2×2 square area; roll for each unit in the area, friend or foe. Infantry in the open gets no infantry save. Can fire a smoke screen instead. (Rulebook p.154)
Artillery Barrage: Artillery barrage: see the unit card and the artillery rules (p.154).
Bombing Run: Bombing run: see the unit card and the aircraft rules.
Cutting: Cutting weapon: each hit rerolls the die, scoring a new hit on dice_block, and so on until a miss. A vehicle with it can perform engineer special actions. (p.155)
Expert: Expert (weapon): hits on dice_block and dice_sight when attacking or sustained attacking with the listed weapon. Never shared with a joined unit. (p.166 + FAQ)
Flame: Flame weapon: units hit gain a suppression token and get neither infantry nor cover saves. On a grid, hits every unit (friends included) on the shortest path to the target. (p.156 + errata)
Flame Burst: Flame burst: suppression token, no infantry or cover saves. Blast template; on a grid, all ground units in the target square. (p.158)
Grapple: Grapple: a hit places a stunned token; the target cannot move or march, its first action is Nothing and it cannot fight in close combat. The token is removed if the grappling unit is destroyed or does anything other than Nothing. (p.155)
Grenade: Grenade weapon: infantry hit keeps its infantry save but never gets a cover save. Vehicles keep their cover. (p.155)
Head Shot: Head shot: see the unit card.
Large Ordnance: Large ordnance: targets a point in fire arc, range and line of sight; 2×2 square explosion on a grid (artillery template without a grid). (Errata 02/2019)
Laser: Laser weapon: each hit rolls another die, scoring a new hit on dice_block, until a miss. On a sustained attack, only misses from the initial roll are rerolled. (p.157 + FAQ)
Phaser: Phaser weapon: no cover save; infantry keeps its infantry save. (p.157)
Phosphorus Flame: Phosphorus flame: see the unit card and the flame weapon rules.
Radiation: Radiation: the target must reroll successful saves; never benefits from height advantage. (Errata)
Rail Weapon: Rail weapon: see the unit card.
Reload: Reload weapon: starts with a Loaded token, removed after each shot. A Reload special action restores it (attack + reload possible in the same activation). (p.158)
Salvo: Salvo weapon: normal fire, or a salvo that doubles the dice and removes the Loaded token (Reload to recover it). (p.158)
Savage Animal: Savage animal: hits on dice_block and dice_sight with the listed weapon. (p.172)
Sniper: Sniper weapon: ignores cover and infantry saves; the shooter chooses which model is hit (not the unit leader, unless a hero or the last survivor). (p.158)
Squad Support Weapon: Squad support weapon: crewed by a single model; see the FAQ “Support weapons”.
Tesla: Tesla weapon: a damaged unit gains a stunned token (cannot fight; first action Nothing on its next activation; a single die to attempt a reactive attack). (p.159)
Volley: Volley weapon: limited ammo; choose how many shots to fire, dice are multiplied accordingly. (p.159)
Wire-Guided: Wire-guided weapon: if the unit attacks with this weapon only, it rerolls misses as in a sustained attack. (p.160)
